description: Opt-in @group(1) sim ring: an indexable storage-buffer ring for particles / walkers / photons. Group 0 is at the contract ceiling (bindings 0–13, 2 storage buffers, 4 storage textures), so persistent agents live here instead of in extraBuffer or plasmaBuffer. Shaders that never declare @group(1) keep the single-layout pipeline. Keep in sync with src/renderer/webgpu/simRing.ts (createSimRingBindGroupLayout) — enforced by `npm run verify:device-policy`. Version 2 adds the optional spatialHash binding (3, simHash), off unless a shader definition sets simRing.spatialHash.

bindings.name: simState
bindings.note: Live agent state, one vec4<f32> per element. Written by simState-domain passes.

bindings.name: simIndex
bindings.note: Byte-for-byte snapshot of simState taken by the copy barrier (4 u32 words per state element; bitcast<vec4<f32>> to read). The buffer twin of dataC.

bindings.name: simParams
bindings.note: All u32. stateCount = allocated vec4 elements; indexCount = stateCount * 4; frame = frames since the ring was (re)armed; truncated = 1 when the OOM ladder allocated fewer elements than requested.

wasm.note: WASM_BACKEND_POLICY.md feature freeze: the C++ pipeline keeps bindGroupLayoutCount = 1 and src/wasm/bridge/shader.ts refuses @group(1) WGSL before LoadShader (logged skip, never an emdawn abort).

spatialHash.name: simHash
spatialHash.note: Optional. One buffer: `cellCount` cell heads, then one `next` link per agent. Shaders that declare it use a second group-1 layout (4 bindings); shaders that do not keep the 3-binding layout, and a ring nobody asked a hash of never allocates it. Rebuilt by the frame planner (copy a pre-filled 0xFFFFFFFF buffer over the heads, then one scatter compute pass) only when some graph node reads the simHash role.
spatialHash.domain: Working-size pixel space (config.zw), the space DLA already uses. cell = floor(xy / resolution * 128), x fastest: cellId = cy * 128 + cx.
spatialHash.alive: An agent is hashed iff its simState.xy is finite and inside [0, resolution). Park dead agents at xy < 0.

build.clear: copyBufferToBuffer of a constant emptyHead-filled buffer over the heads (clearBuffer only zero-fills)
build.scatter: each alive agent i: simHash[nextOffset + i] = atomicExchange(&simHash[cellId], i)
build.trigger: graph role `simHash` read by a node; once per frame until a simState write makes the chain stale

spatialHash.limitsNote: group 0 contributes 2 storage buffers (extraBuffer, plasmaBuffer) + simState + simIndex + simHash = 5, under the WebGPU base limit of 8. Checked against device.limits when the first hash pipeline compiles; never added to MINIMUM_COMPUTE_LIMITS.
